1.title: Trump Claims Peace Board Has Plan for Gaza Disarmament
1.summary: There was no immediate comment from Hamas or Israel, and officials gave few details on the plan.

2.title: Alabama Plans Inmate’s Execution After Supreme Court Blocked Last Attempt
2.summary: The state will try again to execute Jeffery Lee — this time, by lethal injection — after courts said doing so using nitrogen gas was “likely unconstitutional.”

3.title: Kennedy Center Halts Free Public Tours After Five Decades of Service
3.summary: The decision to suspend tours indefinitely came after a volunteer tour guide was featured in a Times article detailing President Trump’s dramatic revamp of the Kennedy Center.

4.title: Nirmal Purja among 10 climbers feared missing after avalanche
4.summary: An American, a Chinese national, an Omani and five Nepalis are said to be part of the group feared missing in Pakistan.

5.title: Saudis Form Military Alliance to Protect Red Sea Shipping
5.summary: As the war between the United States and Iran widened, Saudi Arabia joined with over a dozen other countries, including Egypt and Turkey, to form a new defense coalition to stop attacks on shipping in the Red Sea.

6.title: Anthropic says AI models hacked three firms during tests
6.summary: It comes just days after rival OpenAI said rogue AI agents had breached other firms' networks.
